Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files with RSA-4096 encryption
Full encryption of certain file types and partial encryption (first 1024 bytes) of others
Uses a public key from C&C server to encrypt files
Deletes shadow volume copies to prevent recovery
Changes desktop wallpaper to ransom image
Drops ransom note and executes ransom window on victim's desktop
Adds registry key to auto-launch ransom note on boot
Uses base64 encoding of original filenames with encrypted extensions
Attack Vector: Execution of TrumpLocker.exe file (distribution method unknown)
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note file: What happen to my files.txt
